title: Grateful Dead Live at Saratoga Performing Arts Center on 1985-06-27
lineage: DAT playback on Sony PCM-R500 > unbalanced XLR analog outputs > Neutrik inputs, Presonus Firebox  (pre-amplification and analog-to-digital) > firewire > PC/WinXP Pro > recorded to 24 bit/96 KHz WAV using Wavelab 5 > mastered with Waves L3 Multimaximizer > rendered to 16/44.1 using Waves IDR (type I dither/ultra shaping) > tracked with CDWAV 1.9 > FLAC
taper: DAT kindly provided for transfer by M.Townshend

ai_review.summary: Top‑notch soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1985 show featuring a smoking Crazy Fingers > Supplication > High Time and an epic Johnny B. Goode/Baby Blue encore.
ai_review.review: This recording delivers crystal‑clear soundboard quality that lets the band's explosive 1985 energy shine through. Highlights include the first‑set burst of Crazy Fingers > Supplication > High Time, a second‑set packed with Truckin' > Spoonful > Black Peter, and a double encore of Johnny B. Goode and Baby Blue. Reviewers consistently praise both the performance and the flawless mix.

ai_rating.rationale: All eight reviews are strongly positive (4–5 stars) and repeatedly commend both the show's vitality and the pristine soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Consistently praised for crystal‑clear mix, strong levels and no reported dropouts or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set bursts with intensity, second set maintains momentum with smooth segues, and the double encore caps a high‑energy night.
